chunks: And the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم said:
"Strengthen yourselves for the fasting of the day by eating suhoor, and for the standing of the night by sleeping at the time of the midday rest."

key_terms.اَلسَّحُورِ: the pre-dawn meal taken to assist with fasting
key_terms.اَللَّيْلِ: the night, when devotional worship is performed
key_terms.صِيَامِ: fasting; abstaining in worship during the day
key_terms.قِيَامِ: standing in worship, especially night prayer

ai.seo_question: How does the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم recommend preparing for fasting and night worship?
ai.summary: This hadith teaches practical means for sustaining acts of worship. It encourages eating suhoor to help with fasting during the day and taking a midday rest to support قيام الليل at night.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.1960 - The Prophet (peace be upon him and his family) said:
"Strengthen yourselves for the fasting of the day by eating suhoor, and for the night prayer by taking a nap during the midday rest (qaylulah)."
